description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested Handler class, which are part of the WPEFramework::Crypto namespace. It declares an interface for a secure socket resource with methods for managing connection state, data transmission, and event handling, likely used for SSL/TLS communication within the project.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: A class representing a secure socket resource that manages SSL/TLS connections, providing methods for connection management, data transfer, and event handling.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: A nested class within SecureSocketPort that handles socket operations, connection states, and data transmission, extending Core::SocketPort.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the secure socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the secure socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Trigger
methods.description: Triggers an event or action on the socket port.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently open.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently closed.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has encountered an error.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the socket connection.
